items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Joe Lowry, Jr., was a jockey on a racetrack and he'd ride the horses and we would entertain in this sort of a boarding house.

ctx.x: The show where Joe Lowry was a jockey -- you know Joe Lowry, Jr., was a jockey on a racetrack and he'd ride the horses and we would entertain in this sort of a boarding house. But the idea was the girls would entertain, too. They did singing, no dancing, just singers. And it was a lovely show and the show was a success.
What was the story in the show?
